entries.why: APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #577: a Discover listing may now name a community other than the default one (communityId): its Join goes to that community's own page with src=discover, it shows no ministry reviews or rating line (those belong to the default community), and its card key includes the community id. Default listings behave exactly as before.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #577: one test covers a community listing's Join link, the absence of ministry reviews, and both kinds of listing side by side. Nothing removed.

APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #577: adds communityListingId and makeCommunitySpaceListing, the public projection of a live public community, checked with readPublicListing before it is written so one bad listing can never fail all of Discover. makeDiscoveryListing is unchanged.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #577: covers the new projection, its read-back, and its refusals. Nothing removed.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #577: accepts an optional communityId (a valid id, never 'default') and passes it through; every other check is unchanged.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #577: covers the optional communityId, accepted and refused. Nothing removed.
APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #577: names the new read-only members route among the community routes, which must write no billing entitlement. The count is unchanged.
